name: Atomic Eagle Limited
summary: Atomic Eagle Limited is a mineral resources entity primarily focused on the procurement, prospecting, and advancement of uranium deposits throughout Africa. The firm possesses full ownership (100%) of the Muntanga project, which encompasses three adjacent mining permits covering 1,136 square kilometers. This significant asset is strategically positioned in Zambia, south of Lusaka and north of Lake Kariba. Furthermore, the company holds an option to acquire a majority 51% interest in the Lundazi exploration license, also located in Zambia. Atomic Eagle Limited's corporate headquarters are situated in West Perth, Australia.
